method: Authorized English-language X session. The registered Latest-search query was rerun for realDailyWire with the frozen UTC window and post-type exclusions. Canonical status URLs and exact UTC timestamps were deduplicated and filtered locally. No About panel was opened and no origin field was collected.
search_exhaustion_note: The X search surface loaded but returned 'Something went wrong' after 15 unique results. Only five were inside the registered UTC window, spanning part of 2026-09-19. This is a recoverable lower bound, not a complete inventory, and cannot be used to freeze the sample.
